277004868.description: This Butz-Choquin Calabash 200 tobacco pipe was made in Saint-Claude, France, a region known for its quality pipe craftsmanship. The pipe features a bent black stem with a light-colored band that resembles faux ivory or bone. The bowl is crafted from polished briar wood showcasing a rich reddish-brown grain pattern. There is visible use inside the bowl, and the finish maintains a glossy shine without any cracks or chips.
